## Branch hours
Downtown Library is open Monday through Thursday from 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., Friday and Saturday from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., and Sunday from noon to 5:00 p.m.

## Locations
The city has Downtown, North Park, and Lakeside branches. Current branch addresses are listed at the library short URL.
